launcher.empty: No sites have kiosk mode enabled yet - a Site Manager can turn it on from that site's own settings.
launcher.explainer: Kiosk mode turns any shared device (a tablet at the entrance, a computer at reception) into a shared clock-in screen: each person picks their own name from the list and enters their own personal kiosk PIN to clock in or out - no login needed on the shared device itself. Your kiosk PIN is separate from your account password. Set or change your own PIN from your Dashboard; an administrator or manager can also set it for you from your profile page under People.
